Welcome to Hooks.gg, the ultimate free message building tool for community builders!


Here you can easily create beautiful custom messages for your server to engage and communicate with your members.


To get started, click or tap on anything you want to edit! Use the menu in the top right to log in and access advanced features like cloud saves and shared messages.


If you ever need any assistance, reach out to us in our support server and we'll be happy to help you!

We're excited to have you here!


This user-friendly interface makes it easy to create custom messages that fit your server's theme and tone. (Hint: Use the Actions menu to toggle between Edit Mode and View Mode.)


Here are just some of the exciting features you'll find in Hooks.gg.
Our message editor is easy to use and understand. No more needing to remember what's what, if you want to change something, just click or tap it!
This editor brings you all the fancy features you're used to from Discord including **inline formatting** and an emoji picker built into supported inputs.
